name: City and County of Denver - Digital Accessibility (Colorado HB21-1110)

laws.cite: Colorado HB21-1110 (C.R.S. 24-85-101 et seq.) and 8 CCR 1501-11 Technology Accessibility Rules (Colorado OIT)
laws.summary: State law requiring Colorado state and local government digital content, public and internal, to meet the OIT accessibility rules based on WCAG 2.1 AA, with statutory damages for violations.

applies_to: All Denver city and county digital content and ICT, public-facing and internal (per HB21-1110).

deadlines.what: HB21-1110 conformance deadline for entities using the HB24-1454 good-faith grace period (original 2024-07-01).
Federal Title II date as extended.

mobile: implied - HB21-1110 covers applications and all digital content; Title II covers mobile apps explicitly.
procurement: Not stated on the city page; OIT rules apply to procured ICT (unverified).
enforcement: Private civil actions under HB21-1110 with statutory damages ($3,500 per violation reported by secondary sources); federal Title II.
notes: Colorado OIT page returned 403; HB21-1110 details and HB24-1454 grace from secondary search summaries (levelaccess, lightspeedsystems). C.R.S. section cite from general knowledge, unverified. Contact: HRCP Disability Rights Division.
